speaker: Doctor
text: I see you are experiencing fatigue, flank pain, and fever shortly after being treated for acute sinusitis. To better understand what might be going on, how long have these symptoms been present, and did you finish the full course of antibiotics prescribed for your sinus infection?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Pyelonephritis.

Given your fever, flank pain, and fatigue persisting after treating sinusitis, you likely have a secondary kidney infection. Please REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis and Urine Culture to confirm the diagnosis and guide antibiotic treatment.
